Go you there, where you may obtain the Name.

YA6U: By Guru's Grace, perform good deeds.
By Guru's grace, do you the good deeds.
FYRW: Imbued with the Naam, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||5||
Imbued with the Name, sing you the praise of God.
ZMTA: Serving the Guru, I have come to understand myself.
Through Guru's service I have understood myself.
A762: The Ambrosial Naam, the Giver of Peace, abides within my mind.
The peace giving Nectarean Name, now abides within my mind.
5R12: Night and day, I am imbued with the Word of the Guru's Bani, and the Naam. ||6||
Night and day I remain absorbed in Gurbani and the Name.
XW2X: When my God attaches someone to Him, only then is that person attached.
If my Lord attaches some one to God, then can One become attached to Him.
7E2F: Conquering ego, he remains awake to the Word of the Shabad.
If one stills ego, he remains awake to the Name.
R36Z: Here and hereafter, he enjoys lasting peace. ||7||
Here and afterwards there, he ever enjoys peace.
E4LF: The fickle mind does not know the way.
The mercurial mind knows not the way.
4TR7: The filthy self-willed manmukh does not understand the Shabad.
The filthy apostate understands not the Name.
0J0N: The Gurmukh chants the Immaculate Naam. ||8||
The pious person utters the Immaculate Name.
RH6H: I offer my prayer to the Lord,
I make supplication before reverend God, that,
18GK: that I might dwell in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
I may acquire an abode in the society of the saintly persons.
0ZHR: There, sins and sufferings are erased, and one is illumined with the Lord's Name. ||9||
Such a saintly society removes sins and sufferings and blesses with the light of God's Name.
MAY5: In reflective meditation, I have come to love good conduct.
By reflecting over Guru's gospel, I have come to enshrine great love for good conduct.
18MK: Through the Word of the True Guru, I recognize the One Lord.
Through the hymns of the True Guru I have recognised the One Lord.
D1J7: O Nanak, my mind is imbued with the Lord's Name. ||10||7||
With Lord's Name, Nanak's soul is imbued.
PUQP: The mind of the faithless cynic is like a crazy elephant.
The mind of the mammon-worshipper is a mad elephant.
8HC3: It wanders around the forest, distracted by attachment to Maya.
It wanders about distracted in the forest of worldly attractions.
VNP6: It goes here and there, hounded by death.
Under the pressure of death, is goes here and there.
USDU: The Gurmukh seeks, and finds his own home. ||1||
Under Guru's instruction, it shall find its home.
UMRC: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the mind finds no place of rest.
Without the Guru's word the mind finds not the place of rest.
VDQX: Remember in meditation the Lord's Name, the most pure and sublime; renounce your bitter egotism. ||1||Pause||
Remember you the Lord's very pure Name and relinquish the bitter pride. Pause.
16ME: Tell me, how can this stupid mind be rescued?
Say, how can this stupid soul be rescued?
N8QS: Without understanding, it shall suffer the pains of death.
without (true) understanding, it shall suffer the torture of death.
7ZNU: The Lord Himself forgives us, and unites us with the True Guru.
The Lord Himself pardons and unites man with the True Guru.
BU6A: The True Lord conquers and overcomes the tortures of death. ||2||
The True One crushes and destroys the tortures of death.
2SXE: This mind commits its deeds of karma, and this mind follows the Dharma.
This mind does the deeds and this very mind practises truthfulness.
ZEGL: This mind is born of the five elements.
This mind is born of the five elements.
ADPY: This foolish mind is perverted and greedy.
This foolish soul is perverse and avaricious.
3RYQ: Chanting the Naam, the mind of the Gurmukh becomes beautiful. ||3||
By remembering the Name, through the Guru, the soul becomes beautiful.
MW83: The mind of the Gurmukh finds the Lord's home.
Through the Guru, the soul finds that Lord's abode.
PPDL: The Gurmukh comes to know the three worlds.
Through the Guru, it comes to posses the knowledge of the three worlds.
VTRL: This mind is a Yogi, an enjoyer, a practicer of austerities.
This soul is a Yogi and an enjoyer and practises penance.
FFX7: The Gurmukh understands the Lord God Himself. ||4||
By means of the Guru, it itself understands the Lord God.
Y3VZ: This mind is a detached renunciate, forsaking egotism.
Sometimes the soul renounces the world and gets rid of egotism.
65H5: Desire and duality afflict each and every heart.
To every soul, desire and duality are attached.
FZUT: The Gurmukh drinks in the Lord's sublime essence;
He who, through the Guru, quaffs Divine elixir,
CL1A: at His Door, in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, He preserves his honor. ||5||
in His court and mansion the Sovereign Lord saves the honour of him.
CY8H: This mind is the king, the hero of cosmic battles.
This mind is the King and the hero of battles.
EF8U: The mind of the Gurmukh becomes fearless through the Naam.
By meditating on the Name, through the Guru, this soul becomes fearless.
U93L: Overpowering and subduing the five passions,
Overpowering and arresting the five evil passions
W9DG: holding ego in its grip, it confines them to one place. ||6||
and holding ego in its grip, the soul confines them to one place.
45SJ: The Gurmukh renounces other songs and tastes.
By Guru's grace, the soul renounces other songs and relishes.
DBTZ: The mind of the Gurmukh is awakened to devotion.
By Guru's grace this soul awakens to Lord's service.
GLRZ: Hearing the unstruck music of the sound current, this mind contemplates the Shabad, and accepts it.
Reflecting over the accepting the Guru's instruction, the soul hearts the heavenly music.
YNZL: Understanding itself, this soul becomes attuned to the Formless Lord. ||7||
By understanding itself, the soul becomes the Formless Lord.
REN5: This mind becomes immaculately pure, in the Court and the Home of the Lord.
This soul becomes pure in the court and presence of the Lord,
83GY: The Gurmukh shows his love through loving devotional worship.
it comes to profess love for His devotional service through the Guru.
KW53: Night and day, by Guru's Grace, sing the Lord's Praises.
By Guru's grace, the soul, day and night, sings God's praise,
XHGW: God dwells in each and every heart, since the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages. ||8||
and realises that He, the Lord, is pervading all the hearts, since the very outset and at the beginning of ages.
G3ML: This mind is intoxicated with the sublime essence of the Lord;
With the Nectar of Lord's Name, this soul is intoxicated,
AJUN: The Gurmukh realizes the essence of totality.
and through the Guru, it realises, God, the Home of all the essences.
4WSP: For the sake of devotional worship, he dwells at the Guru's Feet.
For the sake of Lord's meditation, it ought to abide in the Guru's feet.
2UZS: Nanak is the humble servant of the slave of the Lord's slaves. ||9||8||
Nanak, is the slave of the slave of God's slave.

YLKZ: When the body perishes, whose wealth is it?
When the body perishes, whose is called its wealth?
UN5W: Without the Guru, how can the Lord's Name be obtained?
Without the Guru, how can the Lord's Name be obtained?
EH7P: The wealth of the Lord's Name is my Companion and Helper.
The wealth of the Lord's Name is my companion and helper.
UT4L: Night and day, center your loving attention on the Immaculate Lord. ||1||
Immaculate is he, who day and night, fixes his attention on God.
WJG0: Without the Lord's Name, who is ours?
who is mind without the Lord's Name?
6817: I look upon pleasure and pain alike; I shall not forsake the Naam, the Name of the Lord. The Lord Himself forgives me, and blends me with Himself. ||1||Pause||
Deeming pain and pleasure alike, I forsake not the Name. The Lord pardons and blends me with Himself. Pause.
GDMW: The fool loves gold and women.
The fool loves gold and damsel.
EEW3: Attached to duality, he has forgotten the Naam.
Attached to duality he has forgotten the Name.
MMCH: O Lord, he alone chants the Naam, whom You have forgiven.
Him, whom You pardonest, You cause to repeat Your Name.
MJG6: Death cannot touch one who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||
Death's myrmidon cannot touch him, who sings God's praises.
E1T2: The Lord, the Guru, is the Giver; the Lord, the Sustainer of the World.
My Omnipresent God, You are the Great Giver and the world cherisher.
7506: If it is pleasing to Your Will, please preserve me, O Merciful Lord.
As it pleases You, so do You preserve me, O merciful Master.
U2Q3: As Gurmukh, my mind is pleased with the Lord.
Under Guru's instruction, the Lord has become pleasing to my mind.
F9RA: My diseases are cured, and my pains are taken away. ||3||
My afflictions are removed and pain is warded off.
WNZZ: There is no other medicine, Tantric charm or mantra.
There is no other medicine, charm and spell.
MNVJ: Meditative remembrance upon the Lord, Har, Har, destroys sins.
ULVY: You Yourself cause us to stray from the path, and forget the Naam.
You Yourself strayest the mortals and they forget Your Name, O Lord.
3N8R: Showering Your Mercy, You Yourself save us. ||4||
Showering Yours benediction, You Yourself savest.
BAL3: The mind is diseased with doubt, superstition and duality.
The soul is diseased with doubt differentiation and duality.
1YA9: Without the Guru, it dwells in doubt, and contemplates duality.
Without the Guru, one wanders in doubt and remembers the other.
MPA9: The Guru reveals the Darshan, the Blessed Vision of the Primal Lord.
To see the sight of the Guru amounts to be holding, the primal Lord.
DS7V: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, what use is human life? ||5||
without the Guru, hymns of what account is hue human life?
5Y8K: Beholding the Marvellous Lord, I am wonder-struck and astonished.
Beholding the wonderful Lord, I am greatly astonished.
GEEX: In each and every heart, of the angels and holy men, He dwells in celestial Samaadhi.
Among all the hearts of demigods and men, the Lord is contained in the trance of equipoise.
JFFM: I have enshrined the All-pervading Lord within my mind.
The fully pervading Lord, I hold within my mind.
5RV6: There is no one else equal to You. ||6||
Equal to You, there is not another, O Lord.
A26F: For the sake of devotional worship, we chant Your Name.
For Your worship Your Name is uttered by mouth.
V94X: The Lord's devotees dwell in the Society of the Saints.
In the society of the saints and pious persons, the Lord abides.
9FRL: Breaking his bonds, one comes to meditate on the Lord.
Shattering his shackles, the mortal should meditate on God.
4RWZ: The Gurmukhs are emancipated, by the Guru-given knowledge of the Lord. ||7||
The Guru-ward are emancipated by the knowledge of God, acquired through the Guru.
00ZP: The Messenger of Death cannot touch him with pain;
Death's myrmidon and pain touch not him,
9HZ1: the Lord's humble servant remains awake to the Love of the Naam.
the man who is awake in the love of Lord Name.
A2MM: The Lord is the Lover of His devotees; He dwells with His devotees.
God, the lover of His devotees, abides with His devotees.
0W74: O Nanak, they are liberated, through the Love of the Lord. ||8||9||
Nanak, through God, love, the mortal is emancipated.
4N6K: One who serves the Guru, knows his Lord and Master.
He, who serves the Guru, knows the Lord.
ZXV0: His pains are erased, and he realizes the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||
By recognising the true Name his pain vanishes.
DMTF: Meditate on the Lord, O my friends and companions.
Meditate on the Lord, O my Mate and friend.
MC4J: Serving the True Guru, you shall behold God with your eyes. ||1||Pause||
By serving the True Guru, you shall see the Lord with yours eyes. Pause.
5XT5: People are entangled with mother, father and the world.
Entanglements are mother, father and the world.
RFHP: They are entangled with sons, daughters and spouses. ||2||
Entanglement are sons, daughters and wife.
D20B: They are entangled with religious rituals, and religious faith, acting in ego.
Entanglements are the religious ceremonies, performed through pride.
3Y0A: They are entangled with sons, wives and others in their minds. ||3||
Entanglement are the sons, wife and another's love in the mind.
8H62: The farmers are entangled by farming.
Entanglement is the cultivation done by the cultivators.
JQZP: People suffer punishment in ego, and the Lord King exacts the penalty from them. ||4||
For his ego man suffers punishment, and the King demands penalty from him.
3EWC: They are entangled in trade without contemplation.
Entanglement is trade without God's meditation.
5ACD: They are not satisfied by attachment to the expanse of Maya. ||5||
The mortal is not satisfied with the extension of worldly love.
K0RH: They are entangled with that wealth, amassed by bankers.
Entanglement is the perishable wealth, which the bankers amass.
8QL4: Without devotion to the Lord, they do not become acceptable. ||6||
Without God's meditation, the mortal becomes not acceptable.
98HS: They are entangled with the Vedas, religious discussions and egotism.
Entanglement are Vedas, religious discussions and pride.
SM1X: They are entangled, and perish in attachment and corruption. ||7||
By the entanglements of worldly love and sins, the man perishes.
XEK1: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord's Name.
Nanak has sought the protection of the Lord's Name.
5DRA: One who is saved by the True Guru, does not suffer entanglement. ||8||10||
He, whom the True Guru saves, suffers no entanglement.

D6N8: Raag Aasaa, First Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, Third House:
PVWJ: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but One God. By True Guru's grace He is attained.
GKK3: Those heads adorned with braided hair, with their parts painted with vermillion
The heads, that are adorned with tresses, and whose partings are filled with vermilion.
URF1: those heads were shaved with scissors, and their throats were choked with dust.
Those heads are shaves with scissors and the throats are choked with dust.
XC2L: They lived in palatial mansions, but now, they cannot even sit near the palaces. ||1||
These ladies lived in palaces, but now they are not allowed to sit even near the palaces.
QQ1H: Hail to You, O Father Lord, Hail to You!
Hail, father! hail! hail! O Primal Lord,
9R10: O Primal Lord. Your limits are not known; You create, and create, and behold the scenes. ||1||Pause||
Your limit is not known You continuously makest and beholdest various scenes. Pause.
FTZJ: When they were married, their husbands looked so handsome beside them.
When they were married, their bridegrooms seemed handsome beside them.
B7NL: They came in palanquins, decorated with ivory;
The came seated in palanquins, which were adorned with ivory.
H9A6: water was sprinkled over their heads, and glittering fans were waved above them. ||2||
Water was sacrificed over their heads and glittering fans were waved just above them.
MHK1: They were given hundreds of thousands of coins when they sat, and hundreds of thousands of coins when they stood.
They were given lacs of rupees, when they sat and lacs were offered when they stood.
CPB6: They ate coconuts and dates, and rested comfortably upon their beds.
They are coconuts and dates and enjoyed on the couches.
6STJ: But ropes were put around their necks, and their strings of pearls were broken. ||3||
The ropes are put around their necks and their strings of pearls are broken.
R8LU: Their wealth and youthful beauty, which gave them so much pleasure, have now become their enemies.
Both wealth and youthful beauty, which afforded them pleasure have now become their enemies.
YY3H: The order was given to the soldiers, who dishonored them, and carried them away.
The order was given to the soldiers, who having dishonored them took them away.
NHPA: If it is pleasing to God's Will, He bestows greatness; if is pleases His Will, He bestows punishment. ||4||
If it please Him, He grants greatness, If it please Him He awards punishment.
7Q2C: If someone focuses on the Lord beforehand, then why should he be punished?
If the mortal meditates, on the Lord before hand, then why should he receive punishment.
Z8AM: The kings had lost their higher consciousness, reveling in pleasure and sensuality.
The rulers had lost their conscience in merry making, sensual spectacles and revelments.
5W7H: Since Baabar's rule has been proclaimed, even the princes have no food to eat. ||5||
When Babar's rules was proclaimed, then no (Pathan) price ate his food.
MUUR: The Muslims have lost their five times of daily prayer, and the Hindus have lost their worship as well.
Some lost their five times of prayer, and of some the time of worship is gone.
SDGW: Without their sacred squares, how shall the Hindu women bathe and apply the frontal marks to their foreheads?
Without sacred squares, how shall the Hindu women, now bathe and apply frontal marks?
73B5: They never remembered their Lord as Raam, and now they cannot even chant Khudaa-i||6||
They never remembered their own Ram and now they are not allowed to utter even 'Khuda'.
NB8E: Some have returned to their homes, and meeting their relatives, they ask about their safety.
Some return to their homes, and some meeting them, inquire after the safety of their relations.
ZG0P: For some, it is pre-ordained that they shall sit and cry out in pain.
In the lot of some, it is so written, that they sit and bewail in pain.
MS7F: Whatever pleases Him, comes to pass. O Nanak, what is the fate of mankind? ||7||11||
Whatever pleases Him, that alone does happen, O Nanak! What is man?
54TH: Where are the games, the stables, the horses? Where are the drums and the bugles?
Where are those sports, stables and horses.
4BV9: Where are the sword-belts and chariots? Where are those scarlet uniforms?
Where are drums and bugles? Where are those sword-belts and chariots? Where are those scarlet uniforms?
SK09: Where are the rings and the beautiful faces? They are no longer to be seen here. ||1||
Where are those mirrored finger-rings and beautiful faces, which are no longer seen here.
UJ2F: This world is Yours; You are the Lord of the Universe.
This world is Yours and You are the Lord of Universe.
KZ6H: In an instant, You establish and disestablish. You distribute wealth as it pleases You. ||1||Pause||
In a moment You establishest and disestablishest. You distributest wealth as You pleasest. Pause.
VACF: Where are the houses, the gates, the hotels and palaces? Where are those beautiful way-stations?
Where are those houses, gates, seraglios and mansions and where are those beautiful caravansaries?
L3K2: Where are those beautiful women, reclining on their beds, whose beauty would not allow one to sleep?
Where is that comfortable couch enjoying damsel, by seeing whom one would get no sleep?
MRK3: Where are those betel leaves, their sellers, and the haremees? They have vanished like shadows. ||2||
Where are those betel-leaves, betel-sellers and charming fairies? They have vanished like the shadow.
TGJL: For the sake of this wealth, so many were ruined; because of this wealth, so many have been disgraced.
For this wealth many are ruined and it has disgraced many.
XAEH: It was not gathered without sin, and it does not go along with the dead.
Without misdeeds it is not amassed, and it departs not with the dead.
C0FZ: Those, whom the Creator Lord would destroy - first He strips them of virtue. ||3||
He, whom the Creator Himself destroys, him, He first deprives of virtue.
34P9: Millions of religious leaders failed to halt the invader, when they heard of the Emperor's invasion.
When they heard of invasion of emperor Babar, then millions of religious leaders failed to halt him.

JL99: He burned the rest-houses and the ancient temples; he cut the princes limb from limb, and cast them into the dust.
He burned houses, resting places and strong palaces and the princes, cut into pieces, he causes to roll in dust.
KMFQ: None of the Mugals went blind, and no one performed any miracle. ||4||
No Mughal became blind and no one wrought any miracle.
LE18: The battle raged between the Mugals and the Pat'haans, and the swords clashed on the battlefield.
There raged a battle between the Mughals and Pathans and the sword was wielded in the battle-field.
A3EN: They took aim and fired their guns, and they attacked with their elephants.
They, the Mughals, aimed and fired their guns and they, the Pathans attacked with their elephants.
DTF2: Those men whose letters were torn in the Lord's Court, were destined to die, O Siblings of Destiny. ||5||
They, whose letter has been torn in God's court, must die, O My brethren.
145J: The Hindu women, the Muslim women, the Bhattis and the Rajputs
There were the women of Hindus, Muslims, Bhattis and Rajputs.
EMRS: some had their robes torn away, from head to foot, while others came to dwell in the cremation ground.
The robes of some were torn from head to foot, and some had their dwellings in the cremation ground.
SZBC: Their husbands did not return home - how did they pass their night? ||6||
How did they, whose majestic husbands came not home pass their night?
DKGG: The Creator Himself acts, and causes others to act. To whom should we complain?
The Creator, of Himself, acts and causes others to act. To whom should we complain?
0X9U: Pleasure and pain come by Your Will; to whom should we go and cry?
Weal and woe, O God, are according to Your will. To whom should man go to wail?
JQ8X: The Commander issues His Command, and is pleased. O Nanak, we receive what is written in our destiny. ||7||12||
The Commander issues His command and is pleased. Nanak, the mortal obtains, what is destined for him.
QB3T: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
EFW7: Aasaa, Kaafee, First Mehl, Eighth House, Ashtpadheeyaa:
There is but One God. By True Guru's grace He is obtained.
LKUM: As the shepherd is in the field for only a short time, so is one in the world.
As a herdsman is in the pasture for a short time, so is the mortal in the world.
MYFR: Practicing falsehood, they build their homes. ||1||
The men practise falsehood and build their hearth and home.
KSC6: Wake up! Wake up! O sleepers, see that the travelling merchant is leaving. ||1||Pause||
Awake, awake you sleepers and see that soul, the dealer, is departing.
VMC9: Go ahead and build your houses, if you think you will stay here forever and ever.
Build houses, if you have to stay here for ever and aye.
TV0Q: The body shall fall, and the soul shall depart; if only they knew this. ||2||
If some one were to know it, the body shall fall and the soul shall depart.
NURB: Why do you cry out and mourn for the dead? The Lord is, and shall always be.
Why criest you Alas, alas That Lord is and shall be.
URHH: You mourn for that person, but who will mourn for you? ||3||
You bewailest for him, but who will bewail for you?
Z9RQ: You are engrossed in worldly entanglements, O Siblings of Destiny, and you are practicing falsehood.
My brethren, you are engrossed in worldly affairs and practise falsehood.
ZN5R: The dead person does not hear anything at all; your cries are heard only by other people. ||4||
He, the dead one, hears not at all. You only proclaim to other people.
82FN: Only the Lord, who causes the mortal to sleep, O Nanak, can awaken him again.
Only He, who has lulled him to sleep, O Nanak, shall awaken him.
6C76: One who understands his true home, does not sleep. ||5||
If man know his Real Home, then he sleeps not.
KZ41: If the departing mortal can take his wealth with him,
If the outgoing man has taken some wealth with him,
SFQF: then go ahead and gather wealth yourself. See this, reflect upon it, and understand. ||6||
then you too amass wealth. See understand and realise.
5H23: Make your deals, and obtain the true merchandise, or else you shall regret it later.
Do your dealings, gain your object lest you should regret afterwards.
9KXV: Abandon your vices, and practice virtue, and you shall obtain the essence of reality. ||7||
Forsake vice and pratise virtue, so shall you obtain the Real Thing.
LB18: Plant the seed of Truth in the soil of Dharmic faith, and practice such farming.
Sow the seed of truth in the soil of faith and practise you the tillage of such a type.
Q74R: Only then will you be known as a merchant, if you take your profits with you. ||8||
Then alone you shall be known as a trader, if you departest after taking profit.
BYCY: If the Lord shows His Mercy, one meets the True Guru; contemplating Him, one comes to understand.
If it be Lord's grace, the mortal meets the True Guru and understands his instruction.
E9D9: Then, one chants the Naam, hears the Naam, and deals only in the Naam. ||9||
He then utters the Name, hears the Name and deal only in the Name.
6S26: As is the profit, so is the loss; this is the way of the world.
As is the profit, so is the loss. This has been the way of the world.
4U7U: Whatever pleases His Will, O Nanak, is glory for me. ||10||13||
Whatever pleases Him, that is Nanak's glory.
5LFZ: I have searched in the four directions, but no one is mine.
I have searched in the four directions, but no one is mine.
DW28: If it pleases You, O Lord Master, then You are mine, and I am Yours. ||1||
If it please you, O my Lord, You are mine and all Yours.
H8SE: There is no other door for me; where shall I go to worship?
I have no other door than Yours Whom shall I salute?
BUKB: You are my only Lord; Your True Name is in my mouth. ||1||Pause||
I possess You alone as my Lord. Yours True Name is in my mouth. Pause.
RQU5: Some serve the Siddhas, the beings of spiritual perfection, and some serve spiritual teachers; they beg for wealth and miraculous powers.
Some serve men of miracles to become adepts and religious preceptors and they crave for wealth and supernatural Power.
GHSU: May I never forget the Naam, the Name of the One Lord. This is the wisdom of the True Guru. ||2||
I should not forget the One Name, is the instruction of true Guru.

E8C2: Why do the Yogis, the revellers, and the beggars wander in foreign lands?
What for do the renunciators, revellers and mendicants in tatters roam in foreign land?
3LXA: They do not understand the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and the essence of excellence within them. ||3||
They understand not Guru's instruction and the excellent reality within them.
DSU9: The Pandits, the religious scholars, the teachers and astrologers, and those who endlessly read the Puraanas,
The scholars, teachers and astrologers, ever, read the mythological books.
K37H: do not know what is within; God is hidden deep within them. ||4||
They know not the Yours within The Supreme Lord is concealed in the heart.
RCNF: Some penitents perform penance in the forests, and some dwell forever at sacred shrines.
Some penitents perform penitence in the woods and some, ever dwell at the pilgrim places.
7FU2: The unenlightened people do not understand themselves - why have they become renunciates? ||5||
You unenlightened people understand not themselves, and they have become ascetic for nothing.
DYYZ: Some control their sexual energy, and are known as celibates.
Putting in a effort, some control their semen and call themselves as celibates.
E6Y8: But without the Guru's Word, they are not saved, and they wander in reincarnation. ||6||
Without the Guru's word they are not saved and they wander in transmigration.
94VJ: Some are householders, servants, and seekers, attached to the Guru's Teachings.
Some are householders, Lord's slaves and strivers after truth and are attached to Guru's instruction.
D242: They hold fast to the Naam, to charity, to cleansing and purification; they remain awake in devotion to the Lord. ||7||
They hold fast the Name, charity and ablution and remain awake in God's meditation.
HK1H: Through the Guru, the Gate of the Lord's Home is found, and that place is recognized.
Through the Guru, the gate of Lord mansion is known and the man recognises that place.
YE2X: Nanak does not forget the Naam; his mind has surrendered to the True Lord. ||8||14||
Nanak never forgets the Name and his mind is reconciled to the True One.
H8JX: Stilling the desires of the mind, the mortal truly crosses over the terrifying world-ocean.
Nipping the desires in the very mind, the man assuredly crosses the terrible ocean.
JTRT: In the very beginning, and throughout the ages, You have been the Merciful Lord and Master; I seek Your Sanctuary. ||1||
You, O merciful Lord, wert in the beginning and in the primal age. I have entered Yours asylum.
E0UB: You are the Giver, and I am a mere beggar. Lord, please grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.
You are the Giver, I am a beggar of Yours. My God, grant me a sight of You.
SW5V: The Gurmukh meditates on the Naam; the temple of his mind resounds with joy. ||1||Pause||
By meditating on the Name, through the Guru, the mind mansion rings with joy. Pause.
KQWE: Renouncing false greed, one comes to realize the Truth.
When one renounces the false greed, then does one come to realise the truth.
XT6W: So let yourself be absorbed in the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and know this supreme realization. ||2||
Be absorbed in Guru's instruction and you shall know the Excellent Thing.
V4T3: This mind is a greedy king, engrossed in greed.
This mind is a greedy King and is enamoured of avarice.
GFMJ: The Gurmukh eliminates his greed, and comes to an understanding with the Lord. ||3||
Under Guru's instruction, greed is removed, and man arrives at an understanding with God.
KXC1: Planting the seeds in the rocky soil, how can one reap a profit?
By sowing crop in the calcareous soil, how can one obtain profit?
TT1Z: The self-willed manmukh is not pleased with Truth; the false are buried in falsehood. ||4||
The perverse person is not pleased with truth. The liar is buried in falsehood.
CEL3: So renounce greed - you are blind! Greed only brings pain.
Renounce avarice, O you blind, for greed brings great anguish.
6QN4: When the True Lord dwells within the mind, the poisonous ego is conquered. ||5||
If the True Lord abides within the mind, the poison of ego is removed.
9SE3: Renounce the evil way of duality, or you shall be plundered, O Siblings of Destiny.
Leave aside the evil way of worldliness, my brethren, or you shall be plundered.
P6K6: Day and night, praise the Naam, in the Sanctuary of the True Guru's protection. ||6||
Day and night praise the Name under the Guru's protection.
T46U: The self-willed manmukh is a rock, a stone. His life is cursed and useless.
An apostate is stone and a rock. Accursed and insipid is his life.
4D9S: No matter now long a stone is kept under water, it still remains dry at its core. ||7||
Howsoever much the stone be kept under Water, it remains dry at the core.
4YPU: The Name of the Lord is the treasure; the Perfect Guru has given it to me.
God's Name is wealth and the Perfect Guru has given it to me.
0BMB: O Nanak, one who does not forget the Naam, churns and drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||8||15||
He, who forgets not the Name, churns and drinks the Nectar, O Nanak.
YBB1: The travellers travel from one road to another.
The travelers depart via a different route.
AAWD: The world is engrossed in its entanglements, and does not appreciate the Truth. ||1||
The world is engrossed in worldly affairs and loves not the truth.
DCTD: Why wander around, and why go searching, when the Guru's Shabad reveals Him to us?
Why to wander about, and why to make a search, when Gurbani shows the Lord to us?
LY6Z: Leaving behind egotism and attachment, I have arrived at my own home. ||1||Pause||
Having renounced egoism and worldly attachment, I have arrived at my own Home. Pause.
GTJW: Through Truth, one meets the True One; He is not obtained through falsehood.
Through truth the True One is met. Through falsehood He is not obtained.
HR44: Centering your consciousness on the True Lord, you shall not have to come into the world again. ||2||
Fixing attention on the True Lord, man comes not into the world, again.
3HY7: Why do you weep for the dead? You do not know how to weep.
Why doest you weep for the dead? You knowest not how to weep.
WC94: Weep by praising the True Lord, and recognize His Command. ||3||
Wail in love while praising the True Lord, and recognise His command.
HVM1: Blessed is the birth of one who is destined to abide by the Lord's Command.
Fruitful or Renowned is the advent of him, who is destined by the commander to receive the maintenance of the Name.
58NS: He obtains the true profit, realizing the Lord's Command. ||4||
By realising the Lord's will, the mortal obtains the profit.

8BGU: If it pleases the Commander, one goes to His Court, robed in honor.
If it please the Commander, man goes to His court, dressed in the robe of honour.
QE1E: By His Command, God's slaves are hit over the head. ||5||
By His order, the God's slaves strike at the mortal's head.
AQTC: The profit is earned by enshrining Truth and justice in the mind.
Enshrining truth and justice in the mind, man gains profit.
2B4S: They obtain what is written in their destiny, and overcome pride. ||6||
Then one obtains what it written in his lot and stills his ego.
JT5Z: The self-willed manmukhs are hit over the head, and consumed by conflict.
The infidels are thrashed and are ruined in wranglings.
18JV: The cheaters are plundered by falsehood; they are chained and led away. ||7||
The cheats are plundered by falsehood. They are chained and dispatched.
DE0L: Enshrine the Lord Master in your mind, and you shall not have to repent.
Enshrine the Lord in your mind, then, you shall not have to repent.
KENA: He forgives our sins, when we practice the Teachings of the Guru's Word. ||8||
If man acts up to Guru's teaching, the Lord pardons his sins.
D0YY: Nanak begs for the True Name, which is obtained by the Gurmukh.
Nanak prays for the True Name, which is obtained, through the Guru.
X7T8: Without You, I have no other at all; please, bless me with Your Glance of Grace. ||9||16||
Without You I have none else Look You with favour on me.
PY16: Why should I go searching in the forests, when the woods of my home are so green?
Why should, I go searching in the woods, when my home is a verdant forest.
ZME6: The True Word of the Shabad has instantaneously come and settled in my heart. ||1||
The True Name has come quickly to my heart and has settled there.
HLKJ: Wherever I look, there He is; I know no other.
Wherever I look, there He is. I know no one else.
55CK: Working for the Guru, one realizes the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||1||Pause||
Performing Guru's service, the Lord's presence is realised. Pause.
LZZ4: The True Lord blends us with Himself, when it is pleasing to His Mind.
When man becomes pleasing to His mind, then alone the True Lord blends him with Himself.
XDP5: One who ever walks in accordance with His Will, merges into His Being. ||2||
He, who ever walks according to Lord's will, sinks into His lap.
TF0M: When the True Lord dwells in the mind, that mind flourishes.
The mind, in which the True Lord abides, that mind alone flourishes.
TDHM: He Himself grants greatness; His Gifts are never exhausted. ||3||
The Lord Himself grants greatness and His gifts exhaust not.
JZP7: Serving this and that person, how can one obtain the Lord's Court?
How can man obtain Lord's court, by serving every Dick and Tom?
4QZJ: If someone embarks on a boat of stone, he shall drown with its cargo. ||4||
If one boards a boat of stone, he shall be drowned with its cargo.
CC3B: So offer your mind, and surrender your head with it.
Sell your soul to the Guru and surrender Your head along with.
PX3E: The Gurmukh realizes the true essence, and finds the home of his own self. ||5||
If is through the Guru, that the 'real Thing is recognised and one's own home is found.
CUXK: People discuss birth and death; the Creator created this.
People discuss births and death. That Creator has done all this.
8GBB: Those who conquer their selfhood and remain dead, shall never have to die again. ||6||
They who remain dead by stilling their ego, die not, again.
71CS: Do those deeds which the Primal Lord has ordered for you.
One should accomplish the task which the Primal Lord has enjoined upon him.
JKMV: If one surrenders his mind upon meeting the True Guru, who can estimate its value? ||7||
If man, meeting the True Guru, surrenders his soul to him, who can appraise his worth?
1RL8: That Lord Master is the Assayer of the jewel of the mind; He places the value on it.
That Master is the Assayer of the mind jewels and He sets the price of it.
PSKJ: O Nanak, True is the Glory of that one, in whose mind the Lord Master dwells. ||8||17||
Nanak, true is the glory of him, in whose heart the Lord dwells.
7WVR: Those who have forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are deluded by doubt and duality.
They who have forgotten the Name go astray in another's love and superstition.
RP3Z: Those who abandon the roots and cling to the branches, shall obtain only ashes. ||1||
They, who let go the root and cling to the branches, what do they obtain? Ashes.
NBP5: Without the Name, how can one be emancipated? Who knows this?
Without the Name, if one were to understand, how can one be emancipated?
4X5Z: One who becomes Gurmukh is emancipated; the self-willed manmukhs lose their honor. ||1||Pause||
If man be holy, he is saved, then the perverse person loses his honour. Pause.
7CWG: Those who serve the One Lord become perfect in their understanding, O Siblings of Destiny.
Perfect is the intellect of those, who serve the one Lord, O brother.
QF91: The Lord's humble servant finds Sanctuary in Him, the Immaculate One, from the very beginning, and throughout the ages. ||2||
The slave of God takes shelter in Him, who was in the beginning, and in the primal age, and who is the Immaculate One.
6MJ1: My Lord and Master is the One; there is no other, O Siblings of Destiny.
My Master is one, and there is not another, O brother.
C7KG: By the Grace of the True Lord, celestial peace is obtained. ||3||
By the True Lord's grace, celestial bliss is obtained.
ZPJF: Without the Guru, no one has obtained Him, although many may claim to have done so.
Without the Guru, none has obtained God, though many may say and assert so.
QDQJ: He Himself reveals the Way, and implants true devotion within. ||4||
The Lord Himself shows the way and fixes true devotional service in man's mind.
2VL7: Even if the self-willed manmukh is instructed, he stills goes into the wilderness.
Even if an apostate be instructed, he still goes to the wilderness.
5ERB: Without the Lord's Name, he shall not be emancipated; he shall die, and sink into hell. ||5||
Without God's Name, he shall not be saved, and shall sink into hell after death.
76MV: He wanders through birth and death, and never chants the Lord's Name.
He, who repeats not God's Name, wanders in birth and death.
ZKMR: He never realizes his own value, without serving the Guru. ||6||
Without serving the Guru, His worth cannot be realised.
